description: A note-citation style groups citations by context.page without an endnote branch. The runtime reports nothing and the linter reports the note-numbering advisory alone.
source: const INFO = { id: 'note-page-grouping', title: 'Note page grouping', description: '', citationType: 'note-citation', creator: [], tags: [], documentation: [], license: 'MIT', updated: '2026-11-12' };
citations: contexts.map((context, index) => ({ id: context.id, content: String(noteNumberOf(index)) })),
